items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Somebody said he was trained up in Boston or so. No, sir, he was trained under Professor O'Jay right in Crowley.

ctx.x: High C's. Somebody said he was trained up in Boston or so. No, sir, he was trained under Professor O'Jay right in Crowley. Oh, right in Crowley. Yeah, the man there, Professor O'Jay, had five years conservatory playing in all foreign countries. He played from a bazoon up. And you'd whistle a tune and you'd have a white shirt and you'd write the lead sheet, and about an hour he'd have an arrangement for a six-piece band, and how great he was.
Did you hear Freddie Kepard too? I guess you... I had Freddie Kepard. And that was my favorite.
